source_packet.job_description_text: Senior Tax Associate, Northwind. Reports to the Director. Owns sales tax compliance and partnership tax provisions across production entities. NYC, in-person. Avalara experience preferred.

content: Hi — I'm Cloris. Tell me about the role.
We need a senior tax associate at Northwind, working with the Director on sales tax across our production entities.
Got it — sales tax across production entities. Is that all in-house, or are you looking at someone who would own an Avalara migration?

updates.role_summary: Owns sales tax compliance for production entities, partnering with the Director.

content: In-house for now. The Director runs Avalara herself — the new hire would learn it but not own it day one.
So the new hire is operational on Avalara, not architectural — that tracks. What about the close — does that stay with the Director, or does the new hire own it?

capability_areas.name: Sales tax compliance
capability_areas.description: Owns multi-state sales tax filings end-to-end. Operates Avalara as a tool the Director set up; not responsible for the Avalara architecture in year one.

content: They'd own the close after a quarter or two, working partnership tax provisions for our production entities.

Got it — they earn the close over the first couple of quarters. What about partnership tax provisions — that's its own beast. Do they need to come in builder-grade there, or user-grade with room to grow?

capability_areas.name: Sales tax compliance
capability_areas.description: Owns multi-state sales tax filings end-to-end. Operates Avalara as a tool the Director set up; not responsible for the Avalara architecture in year one.

capability_areas.name: Quarterly close
capability_areas.description: Earns ownership of the close over the first one or two quarters.

capability_areas.name: Partnership tax provisions
capability_areas.description: Works partnership tax provisions for production entities.

content: Builder. They'll be the partnership tax person in the room after 12 months.

Taken together: senior tax associate, owns sales tax operations, learns Avalara from the Director, owns the close after a couple of quarters, builder-grade on partnership tax. I think I have what I need. Want to see the brief I'd run with?

depth_distinction.builder_definition: Owns partnership tax provisions for production entities — comes in or grows into the senior partnership tax voice in the room within 12 months.
depth_distinction.user_definition: Operates the Avalara stack the Director built; runs sales tax filings without owning the architecture.
depth_distinction.edge_case_guidance: Sales-tax-strong but partnership-tax-thin candidates pass if there is evidence they will reach builder on partnership within 12 months.
